featured_reviews.name: Snehal Valivadekar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Excellent Driving Class is situated at Lower Parel, opposite Kamala Mills compound.

Charges - 7500 for 22 days + 4000 for license from RTO. Separate charges for using AC (in case the vehicle you practice on has AC option).

They have off on Thursdays. So no class.

The Theory lectures are conducted on alternate Sundays - 10-12 AM.

I took training for Ertiga, from Rakesh Master and is very professional, patient, a good teacher.

Learners license :
1. There is RTO exam application to practice questions with time option, so before going for exam you want to practice the questions.
2. In case you fail, you may re-appear for the test again one week after that date.
3. RTO charges 100 as fine for reappearing learners test.
4. There are 15 questions out of which 9 is passing.

Overall it has been a very good experience at Excellent Driving School. Very well trained Teachers / Driving masters. Responsive staff.  I have personally extended my period of class to get good hands on experience before driving test.

featured_reviews.name: Kamran Alam
featured_reviews.review_text:
I enrolled at the NEW INDIA MOTOR TRAINING SCHOOL for the 20-day four-wheeler course feeling completely hopeless. Honestly, I genuinely believed I would never be able to drive a car. The thought of navigating Mumbai traffic was terrifying.
However, the 17 days that followed completely changed my life.
The instructors here are absolutely brilliant. They don't just teach you how to operate a car; they teach you how to be confident and safe on the road. The training was structured, patient, and focused entirely on real-world application. They systematically broke down every element, from clutch control to lane changing, making the process far less intimidating than I imagined.
The ultimate test came on Day 17. I had been driving under supervision, but that day, I drove all alone to Bandra Terminus to pick up my brother. If you know Bandra Terminus, you know that's not a spot for nervous drivers! It was an incredibly proud moment. Everyone in my family was thrilled that I was capable of making such a complex, independent trip after such a short time.
The NEW INDIA MOTOR TRAINING SCHOOL didn't just teach me a skill; they gave me a huge boost of self-confidence and freedom. If you're starting from zero, struggling with fear, or think driving is impossible for you—sign up here. They will prove you wrong. Highly, highly recommended!
